reason: Agreed with the Director's ruling: the laptop brain is the base stone and moves to the cloud; the laptop becomes a client. Proposal 40 says the same in its own words.
proposalText: {"title":"Move the brain to the cloud","summary":"The brain must be moved to the cloud.","why":"Today the brain (the gbrain daemon and its store) lives on the HP laptop: it stops when the laptop sleeps, it is reachable only on this machine, and the widget, the builders and your other sessions cannot share it from anywhere else. In the cloud it runs all the time, one copy for everything that feeds it or reads it, and the laptop becomes a client.","technical":"Host the gbrain daemon (currently 127.0.0.1:3131) on a private VPS with its database and embeddings; sync the seven sources plus worklog and trilogy-widget to it; point the widget, kba_sync, the capture jobs and the case-review pass at GBRAIN_URL over TLS with a token; keep the litellm judge env on the host; the laptop keeps a read-through cache for offline reads. Note the tension with proposal 40 ('gbrain on the HP laptop is the base'): this proposal makes the cloud the base and the laptop a feeder, so one of the two must be chosen.","risk":"Medium: caselogs carry customer names and internal notes, so the host must be private with authentication and encrypted at rest; the Kayako 2nd-brain docs were secret-scanned once and must be re-scanned before any copy leaves the machine; capture latency rises for large pages.","effort":"One work package: host, sync, endpoint switch in the widget, then the rest of the tools.","refs":["proposal 40","gbrain daemon :3131","WP24 to be specified","draft draft-mu6q0ssw-bjctel"],"from":"director","filed_at":"2026-09-18T08:53:29.238Z","drafted_by":"director","completed_by":"wren"}

reason: One record or none. The ingest in personal@93beccc already reads Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai, ChatGPT, vault and handoff files; it needs repointing at gbrain, not rewriting.
proposalText: {"title":"One consolidated record of all sessions across machines and providers","summary":"all data from windows, mac and cloud sessions across providers should be consolidated.","why":"Work happens in Claude Code on this Windows laptop, on a Mac, in cloud sessions, and with other providers, and each keeps its own transcripts, memories and captures. Decisions made in one place are invisible in the others. Consolidating them into the brain gives one searchable record of what was said and decided anywhere.","technical":"A collector per source: Claude Code project transcripts (JSONL under ~/.claude/projects on each machine), the memory directories, cloud session exports, and other providers' exports (ChatGPT export via the existing chatgpt-parser in peoplenet-foundation); each collector distils sessions into brain pages under a 'sessions' source with date, machine, provider, topics and decisions, secret-scanned before capture (the 2nd-brain rule), never raw transcripts; a daily sync from each machine to the brain, which makes this depend on proposal 42 (the brain in the cloud) or on a sync to the laptop while it is awake.","risk":"High on privacy: transcripts contain customer data, credentials typed in chats, and personal material; capture only distilled, scanned pages, keep the raw files on their machines, and exclude anything the Director marks private.","effort":"One work package after 42; one collector at a time, Windows first.","refs":["proposal 42","proposal 40","peoplenet-foundation chatgpt-parser","draft draft-mu6q1ksn-9qj6ow"],"from":"director","filed_at":"2026-09-18T08:54:07.496Z","drafted_by":"director","completed_by":"wren"}

reason: For, with one order of work: the chain and governance server move to their own cloud box before any builder does, or a cloud builder cannot file, vote or read JD. The laptop sleeping is the cause of every stall this week except the silent-command watchdog, which cloud sessions have too; long runs still go to the background with output to a file.
proposalText: {"title":"Run the builders as cloud agents so their sessions can be resumed","summary":"only use cloud agents so sessions can be resumed when needed.","why":"This week's builders ran on the laptop and were stopped by the machine sleeping, by a watchdog on long silent commands, and by context running out, each time leaving work uncommitted until someone noticed. A cloud agent keeps running when the laptop sleeps and can be resumed with its context intact, so the queue moves without the Director or Wren babysitting it.","technical":"Run the standing widget builder and the governance builder as Claude Code cloud sessions (remote isolation) with the repo checked out there; the local chain and the governance server then need to be reachable from the cloud or moved with them (this depends on proposal 42, the brain in the cloud, and on where the Hardhat node lives); the laptop keeps the widget itself, STAR and Kayako access; reports still come to Wren over the same channel; commits push to origin instead of staying local.","risk":"Medium: the repos and the brain content would leave the machine (proposal 44's masking decision and the secret-scan rule apply first); the local chain would need a persistent home; cloud sessions are billed.","effort":"One work package after 42; a trial with one builder first.","refs":["proposal 42","proposal 44","draft draft-mu6u5qs8-p5hfn9"],"from":"director","filed_at":"2026-09-18T10:50:22.877Z","drafted_by":"director","completed_by":"wren"}
